root_causes.description: The email container (email-7699887dd9-rnbxw) is being repeatedly killed and restarted in a crash/back-off loop after a container definition change, while its caller (checkout) and sibling leaf services stay nominal. This matches the known email pod_crash pattern of rolling container churn.

evidence.query_or_id: BackOff: Back-off restarting failed container email in pod email-7699887dd9-rnbxw_otel-demo(c9cf2589-71fd-45ed-bb7c-39ada7acd0a9) (count=5)
evidence.observed_value: count=5 back-off restart events for container 'email' in pod email-7699887dd9-rnbxw during the window
evidence.expected_baseline: 0 restart/back-off events for a healthy pod

evidence.query_or_id: Killing: Container email definition changed, will be restarted (count=2)
evidence.observed_value: count=2 explicit container-restart triggers ('container definition changed')
mean=63279104 B, p50=40583168 B, p95=154060800 B, max=154103808 B (approx 40MB to 154MB sharp fluctuation)
evidence.expected_baseline: stable working-set with no ~4x sawtooth across the window

root_causes.description: A minor, non-significant frontend error rate (max approx 0.01/s) was observed; likely downstream noise rather than the root cause, since email is a leaf called only by checkout and frontend errors stay near zero.
Checkout is the direct caller of email; a prolonged email crash loop could surface as a checkout-side dependency issue, but checkout error rate and CPU remained flat so this is not the primary fault.

remediation_steps: Run 'kubectl describe pod email-7699887dd9-rnbxw -n otel-demo' to read the restart/back-off events and container exit codes and confirm the pod is in CrashLoopBackOff.
Inspect the email container spec/ConfigMap for the recent 'container definition changed' trigger and roll back the change that forced repeated restarts.
Resolve the pause/sandbox image pull errors (gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest ImagePullBackOff) so pod sandbox creation succeeds, or pre-pull/allow-list the image.
Once the container stabilizes, confirm the email memory working set is flat and no further 'Back-off restarting failed container' events appear.
